title: Client Success Manager
description:
About Enertiv

Enertiv is a leading proptech SaaS platform that integrates hardware-enabled data collection with AI-powered analytics to transform how commercial real estate portfolios are operated. Our technology enables owners and operators to reduce operating costs, improve sustainability, and deliver enhanced tenant experiences.

We’re at a pivotal moment in our growth. To scale effectively, we need stronger operational foundations, clearer accountability, and disciplined execution. This role is designed for a senior operations leader with a strong engineering mindset who can build the systems, standards, and operating rhythms required for our next phase.

Client Success Manager

Reports to: Manager, Client Success

Location: Full time, US Remote (Colorado candidates preferred), minimal travel.

Compensation: $85,000-$105,000 base + potential performance bonus + equity

The Role

To support our continued growth, Enertiv is seeking an experienced Client Success Manager to build strategic client relationships, drive platform adoption, and help clients realize measurable business value. This individual will manage a portfolio of high-value clients, partnering closely with the Account Management (AM) team to drive retention and account growth while serving as the primary owner of customer health, adoption, value realization, and long-term success. This position reports directly to the Manager of Client Success and can be based remotely within the U.S.

This role represents a unique opportunity to join a fast-moving, mission-driven team that's helping modernize and decarbonize the real estate industry.

What You’ll Own

• Partner with the Onboarding team throughout kickoff and implementation to ensure a strong foundation, accelerate time-to-value, and lead cross-functional resolution of client delivery and support issues across maintenance, data, software, and ESG workflows.

• Own customer health by monitoring health signals, maintaining accurate account data, and proactively mitigating risk before issues impact retention.

• Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) focused on adoption, platform health, and value realization, while partnering with AM team on Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) centered on strategic outcomes and long-term business value.

• Partner with the Asset Performance Services (APS) team to deliver client insights, measurement and verification (M&V) reporting, and proof-of-value deliverables that reinforce customer outcomes.

• Partner with the AM team to identify expansion opportunities, support renewal planning, and advance long-term account growth through proactive forecasting and strategic account planning.

• Act as the voice of the customer by surfacing client feedback and market insights to Product and Leadership to influence roadmap priorities and service improvements.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days:

• Build a strong foundation: Complete Enertiv platform and industry onboarding, establish relationships with key client stakeholders, and confidently articulate Enertiv 's value proposition.

• Successfully transition your portfolio: Deliver or schedule initial QBRs for priority accounts while maintaining accurate CRM data, customer health scores, and renewal forecasts.

Ongoing:

• Drive customer value and adoption: Deliver impactful QBRs, increase platform engagement, and achieve 60%+ multi-product adoption by aligning Enertiv 's solutions to customer business objectives.

• Build trusted client partnerships: Develop relationships with two or more key stakeholders per account, serving as a strategic advisor to Asset Management, Sustainability/ESG, and Property Management leaders.

• Support retention and account growth: Partner with the AM team to proactively mitigate risk, maintain 120%+ net revenue retention and 95%+ gross revenue retention, and advance upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities contributing to $500K+ in annual net new ARR.

• Demonstrate strategic impact: Consistently

title: Telemarketing Agent
description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle , we connect high-performing B2B sales professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top sales talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle .
Role Type: Full-time
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Industry: Telemarketing (Experience required)
Job Summary

We are looking for a professional, empathetic, and driven Telemarketing Agent to join a specialist corporate triage programme. This team helps company directors navigate complex financial challenges by providing a clear pathway to resolution. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for business leaders, acting as a critical bridge between their initial inquiry and the expert support they need. You won’t be giving advice; instead, you will be qualifying leads and ensuring every director is matched with the right outcome pathway at the right time
Key Responsibilities

• Handle inbound inquiries from company directors seeking guidance on their financial position.

• Perform outbound calls to warm leads generated through targeted marketing campaigns.

• Conduct structured triage conversations to qualify cases and assess the director's specific needs.

• Accurately document all call activity, case notes, and lead information within the CRM.

• Schedule follow-up appointments and facilitate seamless hand-offs to the specialist teams.

• Proactively identify re-engagement opportunities within existing data sets.

• Collaborate with the programme lead to provide performance updates and process feedback.

• Assist with data management and lead tracking to ensure the pipeline remains organized.

Requirements

• Proven experience in telemarketing, outbound sales, or a professional customer-facing phone role.

• Exceptional communication skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly.

• The ability to follow a structured conversation framework naturally, avoiding a "scripted" feel.

• Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail for precise data entry.

• Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Excel.

• A self-motivated mindset with a focus on hitting targets and achieving quality outcomes.

Nice-to-Haves

• Prior experience within financial services, debt solutions, or business support sectors.

• Experience working in a performance-led or lead-generation environment.

• Knowledge of corporate insolvency or business recovery terminology.

Benefits
💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams
🚀 Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services
🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network
🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

title: Head of Americas Talent Acquisition
description:
Job Description
About Agilent
Agilent Technologies is a global leader in life sciences, diagnostics, and applied chemical markets, delivering instruments, software, services, and consumables that advance the quality of life. Our solutions help scientists and clinicians answer some of the world's most important questions - from developing new therapeutics and advancing cancer diagnostics to ensuring the safety of food, water, and the environment. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Agilent employs approximately 18,000 people worldwide serving laboratories across pharma, biotech, clinical, chemical, environmental, food, academic, and government markets.
The Role
Agilent Global TA is conducting a search for a Head of Americas Talent Acquisition to lead hiring strategy and execution across the Americas. As a member of the Talent Acquisition Leadership Team (TALT) this leader will own the full recruiting engine for the Americas region - leading a team of Lead TA Partners, Senior TA Partners, and TA Partners - collaborating with senior business and functional leaders on workforce planning, and building the processes, tools, and employer brand that allow Agilent to attract exceptional scientific, engineering, commercial, and operations talent. The talent we hire directly shapes our ability to innovate for the lab of the future - this is a high-visibility leadership role at the heart of that mission.
What You'll Do

Leadership & Strategy

• Own the Americas talent acquisition strategy, translating business goals and headcount plans into an executable hiring roadmap across R&D, manufacturing, field service, commercial, and corporate functions

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Lead/Senior/TA Partners; set clear goals, develop talent, and build a high-performance, inclusive team culture aligned with the One Agilent values of integrity, respect, teamwork, and accountability

• Serve as a trusted advisor to executives and hiring leaders on org design, market intelligence, compensation trends, and the availability of specialized talent - from analytical chemists and molecular biologists to software engineers and field service professionals

• Partner with Finance and HR leadership on annual and quarterly workforce planning, capacity modeling, and hiring prioritization

Execution & Operations

• Drive predictable delivery against hiring targets across high-volume, niche scientific/technical, and executive searches; personally lead select senior searches

• Build and continuously improve recruiting processes, interviewer training, and candidate experience from first touch to signed offer

• Define and report on TA metrics (time-to-fill, pipeline conversion, offer-accept rate, quality of hire, cost per hire, source effectiveness) and use data to drive decisions

• Own the regional TA tech stack (ATS, sourcing and scheduling tools, AI-enabled recruiting tools) and vendor/agency relationships and budgets

• Build talent pipelines for hard-to-fill scientific and engineering disciplines through university partnerships, early-career programs, industry associations, and scientific communities

Qualifications
What You'll Bring

• 10+ years of talent acquisition experience, including 4+ years leading and scaling recruiting teams, ideally across multiple countries in the Americas

• A track record of delivering both volume and senior-level hiring in the life sciences, diagnostics, biotech, MedTech, scientific instrumentation, or technology sectors

Job Summary

Equinix Fabric is the world's leading Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) interconnection platform, operating across 65+ global metros and connecting enterprises, hyperscalers, and network service providers through carrier-class ethernet. The core ethernet layer - EPL, EVPL, and virtual connections - is the revenue engine at the heart of Fabric.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own this core ethernet services portfolio, spanning Fabric EPL/EVPL virtual connections, port and LAG management, service tokens, and Equinix Metro Connect (Fabric Metro Connect). This leader will shape how customers consume physical and virtual Layer 2 connectivity through a simpler, more unified portfolio to improve customer experience and strengthen Fabric's position as the default interconnection platform for cloud, AI, and enterprise networking.

This is a senior individual contributor role with P&L accountability, direct customer engagement, and a direct line to the product leadership team. You will define the roadmap, make the business case for investment, influence cross-functional execution, and help shape the next generation of Equinix 's flagship Ethernet services.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

• Define the 3-year vision and quarterly roadmap for Fabric EPL/EVPL virtual connections, port and LAG architectures, service tokens, and Equinix Fabric Metro Connect

• Lead the strategic convergence of Fabric virtual connections and packet-based Metro Connect, simplifying customer choice while increasing attach, adoption, and portfolio value. Drive the ethernet services product toward higher speeds (400G+), broader metro availability, and richer service types (E-Line, E-LAN, E-Tree, multipoint)

• Shape the MACsec, QoS, and resiliency roadmap in partnership with engineering and network architecture

P&L & Business Case Ownership

• Own the Fabric ethernet and Fabric Metro Connect P&L - revenue, attach rate, margin, and competitive pricing

• 7+ years of product mgmt experience, including meaningful ownership of a cloud infrastructure, networking, digital platform, or carrier connectvity products.Build and defend investment cases for major roadmap bets, including capacity expansion, new metro launches, and service type additions

• Partner with Finance and Sales to model WTP (willingness to pay), segment economics, and pricing architecture

• Track and report on product KPIs: port utilization, virtual connection growth, average bandwidth per connection, and customer retention

Technical Product Leadership

• Author precise, engineering-ready PRDs for ethernet service capabilities - VLAN handling, L2CP behavior, redundancy plane design, LAG provisioning, bandwidth tiers

• Be the internal authority on carrier ethernet standards (MEF E-Line, E-LAN, E-Tree; 802.1Q, 802.1ad QinQ, MACsec, LACP)

• Work closely with network architecture on PE node topology, port provisioning, and the physical-to-virtual service binding model

• Engage deeply with the API-first vision - define the OpenAPI surface for ethernet services consumed by enterprise and cloud customers programmatically

Customer & Market Engagement

• Conduct structured discovery with enterprise network architects, cloud on-ramp teams, and carrier customers

• Own the competitive lens on carrier ethernet peers and adjacent NaaS providers

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

- Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant - Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges - Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

- Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world - Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Alpha will be the first stellarator to demonstrate net energy. Achieving this milestone requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating work at the edge of each discipline’s capability. You will own a selected set of the models, stretching over domains, e.g. microwave physics to plasma radiation.These models will be used by the design team to compute load cases, assess system-level tradeoffs, perform numerical optimization, and simulate the whole machine as a single system. You will own these models end-to-end, from definitions of inputs and outputs, to implementation correctness, and software efficiency.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Identify and implement the simulators. Depending on the simulation needs, you will implement a simulator from scratch or wrap an existing tool into our platform, and make sure the model is properly interfaced with our codebase.

- Co-define the input and output interfaces. Work together with the engineering teams to update the data model for input and output to ensure it captures correctly the relevant design specifications.

- Ensure correctness. Ensure simulation pipelines are tested, verified, validated and work correctly as the design evolves. Where needed, help scoping and contribute to validation in hardware tests.

- Exercise the models. Support the integrated design team with dedicated studies to inform design tradeoffs.

- Expose simulators as a service to humans and agents. Create dashboard, online tools, and interactive reports to visualize model prediction and uncertainties and explore the model behaviour, that can be easily used by the entire Alpha design team.

WHO YOU ARE

- Your knowledge ranges across physics, geometry, and numerical methods. You feel comfortable jumping into the complex 3D geometry of a stella

title: Talent Acquisition Partner - GTM Enterprise

Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To make every leader better. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable insights and impactful moments.

We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

The role

Great recruitment is felt by everyone it touches - the candidate who gets a thoughtful answer, the hiring manager who feels truly partnered with, and the team that grows stronger with every hire. We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner who takes ownership of all three.

As our Talent Acquisition Partner for GTM Enterprise, you'll be the dedicated recruitment partner to our Enterprise sales organization across EMEA. You'll own hiring end-to-end for roles like SDRs, Account Executives, Customer Success Managers and Sales Managers from kickoff to signed offer.

This is a 12 -month contract with real ownership from day one. Within your first few months you'll be running 7 - 10 roles in parallel, and hiring managers will see you as a clear, proactive and structured partner. Within six months, you'll own the GTM Enterprise hiring plan, be a trusted voice in Sales Directors' hiring-planning conversations, and have left your mark on how we hire in sales.

Responsibilities

• Own full-cycle recruitment for GTM Enterprise roles across EMEA, from kickoff to offer

• Partner closely with hiring managers to define needs, align expectations and run structured, high-quality processes

• Build proactive pipelines for current and future needs, especially for business-critical roles

• Identify talent risks and upcoming changes in the organization, and act on them early

• Run internal recruitment processes during team changes, internal moves and promotions

• Coach hiring managers on structured, unbiased interviewing and recruitment best practice

• Use data, insights and AI to keep improving hiring quality, speed and candidate experience

 

What will help you succeed

• Have around 6 years of experience as a Talent Acquisition Partner or Recruiter, ideally including time in a SaaS scale-up hiring sales and GTM roles in Stockholm

You're confident sharing a different perspective with hiring managers, and you know when it matters most. You never trade candidate experience for speed.

Why this role, why now

This role exists to build strong teams that support our sales recruitment and long-term growth. You'll see a direct line between your work and where Mentimeter is a year from now.

You'll join an experienced, collaborative TA team with clear ways of working and shared ownership, and a modern toolkit: Greenhouse, Claude, Alva Labs, LinkedIn Hiring Assistant, Notion, Slack and Google Workspace

title: Applied Research Engineer

ABOUT US

Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.

Higharc is seeking a hands-on Applied Research Engineer to turn our spatial AI research into capabilities that homebuyers and builders use. You'll join our Platform R&D team, taking models that have proven themselves in research and shipping them into the product.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Our team builds AI that understands homes, and our generative floor plan engine has moved from proof of concept to a core workflow in Higharc's product. You'll own the applied side of that work. The research team hands you a defined problem and a metric. You train and adapt the models, build the pipelines around them, and ship a component that meets the product's latency and cost budget.

You'll work inside an architecture that already exists. The engine, the schema, and the evaluation frameworks are in place, and your job is to make them faster, reproducible, and easy for others to build on.

Expect to:

- Build the component layer around our layout synthesis engine: a documented API contract, a service the product can call, and an evaluation gate that runs on every change.

- Turn model retraining into a one-command job, with benchmarks built in and results the whole team can read.

- Own the latency and cost budgets for learned capabilities.

- Extend core research into new capabilities, such as multi-story plans and real-time editing.

- Partner with infrastructure engineers on MLOps and deployment, and mentor researchers and interns on engineering practices.

- Share your work in writing through weekly status updates, clear pull requests, and design notes before big changes.

ABOUT YOU

You're happiest when a model you worked on is running in the product. You like taking a well-defined problem with a metric attached and closing it, and you improve an existing codebase without feeling the need to rewrite it. You think about what a 45-second wait means for a user before you think about what it means for a benchmark. You're honest about evaluation: you can tell when a result is an artifact of the test set, and you'd rather report a regression in writing than hide it behind a demo.

Most of your collaborators are remote and some are part-time, so writing things down comes naturally to you. You can go from a research conversation to a product conversation to an infrastructure conversation in the same week and be understood in all three. You also know enough about buildings to see that a bedroom door opening onto a kitchen is wrong before any metric tells you.

You have:

- 5+ years of professional software development, including at least 2 years training and shipping ML models to real users

- Taken at least one model end to end: data preparation, training, evaluation, serving, and the integration that put it in front of users

- Fluency in Python and PyTorch (TensorFlow or Keras is fine if you're ready to move to PyTorch)

- Built or maintained an evaluation harness or benchmark and used it to gate changes

- Packaged a model behind an API (FastAPI or similar) and owned its latency and cost

- A master's degree in computer science, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent shipped work (a PhD is not required)

- Comfort working remotely with a team on US Eastern hours

A major plus if you also bring:

- A background in architecture or building, whether that's a degree, professional practice, or AEC software work

title: Technical Sourcer

About the role

Thatch is changing healthcare benefits. We give companies a way to offer every employee a health budget so they can choose the plan that fits their life, while giving employers predictable, controllable costs. Making that possible means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology.

We look for people who like solving complex problems, take real ownership, and are comfortable working through ambiguity. People here have real responsibility for what gets built and care deeply about doing work that matters.

Talent is how we build the team to do it. As a Technical Sourcer, you’ll focus on Engineering, Product, and Design, building pipelines ahead of our hiring needs and unlocking top-tier talent. You’ll learn what makes people thrive at Thatch, identify the companies, backgrounds, and communities where we’re likely to find them, and build relationships early. You’ll start by owning pipeline generation, then take on candidate screens as you calibrate on our teams, roles, and hiring bar.

What you'll do

• Own pipeline building across Engineering, Product, and Design, flexing into other priority searches as needed.

• Map talent markets and uncover new sources of top-tier talent.

• Build sourcing strategies across outbound, referrals, communities, universities, and new channels.

• Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to define what great looks like and sharpen searches.

• Use data and market insights to spot gaps and adjust strategy.

• Engage candidates from first outreach through screening as you build context and calibrate with our teams.

Background we're looking for

• 2+ years of sourcing or recruiting experience, with experience finding technical talent.

• Strong sourcing fundamentals and a track record of finding hard-to-reach candidates.

• A track record of writing outreach that gets top passive talent interested and drives responses.

• Strong judgment and curiosity, with the ability to learn new talent markets quickly.

• Comfortable using data, experimenting with new approaches, and adapting as priorities change. 

Experience we’d be particularly excited about

• Built talent maps or pipelines from scratch.

• Sourced across Engineering, Product, or Design.

• Deep experience with modern sourcing tools, from LinkedIn Recruiter and Gem to GitHub and AI-powered search, with a track record of finding creative ways to reach talent.

What to expect

We aim to keep our interview process thoughtful, rigorous, and efficient. Most candidates complete it within three weeks.

• A 30-minute conversation with a recruiter.

• A 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager.

• For some roles, a case study, technical exercise, or working session.

• A conversation with a department leader.

• A final conversation with a member of our executive team.

Estimated Compensation Range
$115,000 — $130,000 USD

 

About Thatch

We’re a fully distributed early stage company using technology to change the way America does healthcare. We’re a happy, friendly, high-velocity team. You can read  more on Thatch here .

About Teamshares
Teamshares is one of America's largest buyers of small businesses from retiring owners and is on a mission to make employee ownership the future of small business. We buy promising companies from retiring owners, gifting employees an immediate 10% ownership stake in the business, and supporting their ongoing growth through proprietary software, education, financial products and best-in-class leadership support.
We're building a network of 10,000 employee-owned small businesses, creating $10 billion of stock wealth for wage workers and supporting generations of business owners into confident retirement. Together, we will reduce global wealth inequality while ensuring vital small businesses, and the communities they serve, continue to flourish.
Learn more at teamshares.com
The Opportunity
We are looking for a President to lead the next chapter of a longstanding, highly respected specialty retailer in the Greater Los Angeles area. For decades, this business has been a trusted destination for customers seeking authentic, high-quality health and wellness products and specialty foods, known for product expertise, consistent quality, and personal service. The business serves customers through its retail operations, an ecommerce channel that ships nationwide, and wholesale relationships with business customers. It is a growing company with strong operations, loyal customers, an experienced team, and deep roots in the community it serves.
The ideal fit is a hands-on leader who has experience in specialty retail, consumer products, or food and wellness distribution, whether from running a multi-channel retail business, leading an ecommerce operation, or managing wholesale and distribution accounts. You will partner with an experienced team, and you will take ownership of the vendor relationships, merchandising, and pricing decisions that keep the assortment compelling across every channel. You should be comfortable reading and managing a P&L, with support from an experienced controller. Fluency in Mandarin and English is required for this role; Cantonese is a strong plus.
The first year is about stability and continuity: earning the trust of the team, customers, and vendors as the business transitions to employee ownership, while building the foundation for growth. The exiting owner will remain involved for a transition period to support a smooth handoff. This is also a customer- and community-facing role, and we are looking for someone who wants to be a visible, engaged presence with customers, partners, and the broader community.
This is a full-time, onsite role, five days a week.
What You Will Do:
Serve as President of a longstanding, community-rooted specialty retailer. You will own full P&L responsibility, business strategy, and operations, and will report to a Teamshares Industry Lead who supports a portfolio of companies within the sector.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
ABOUT COLUMN

For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand - builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.

At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!

The opportunity:
We're a lean, experienced engineering team, and we're hiring our first Forward Deployed Engineer. You'll define what this role looks like at Column.

As an FDE, you'll work with customers to understand their problems in depth and help them build new products on Column's APIs. What you learn in the field will feed directly into how our engineering team improves the platform.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll write code, debug payment flows and design integrations, and you'll spend a lot of time on-site with customers. You'll get deep exposure to the full banking stack, from our APIs down to the Federal Reserve.

This role is based in our Presidio office in San Francisco, with frequent travel to customer sites in the US and abroad. You will report directly to William, the CEO.

Read more about Life @ Column and our hiring process here https://www.notion.so/Hiring-at-Column-b8d9b2628317491989d4713091b6bb68?pvs=21. 🚀

What you'll do:

- Work directly with our partner’s engineering teams to design, build and launch products with Column's state-of-the-art banking stack

- Act as the technical owner for strategic customers from onboarding to launch, unblocking them on architecture, ledgering, reconciliation and edge cases in money movement

- Write production-quality code, that speeds up integrations and grows into reusable product

- Turn patterns from the field into product and platform improvements, working closely with engineering to shape our APIs, docs and developer experience

- Advise customers on how to build safe, compliant and resilient financial products in a regulated environment

- Represent Column in conversations with customer executives and engineering leaders, and build trusted, long-term relationships

What we're looking for:

- Need to be fluent in either Spanish, French or Russian.

- Strong engineering fundamentals, ideally with experience in backend systems, APIs or infrastructure

- Product thinking: you look past the immediate ask to the underlying problem and the best solution, for the customer and for Column

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. You can explain complex systems clearly to an engineer or an executive

- Executive presence and the confidence to lead high-stakes customer conversations

- Strong project management skills. You can run several customer engagements at once and keep each one moving

- A self-starter mindset. You're comfortable with ambiguity and with building process where none exists yet

- Experience with payments, banking or financial infrastructure is a plus

WHAT YOU’LL GET FROM US:

- 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents!

- 🐣 Comprehensive family planning and fertility benefits via partnership with Carrot, including reimbursement of up to $20,000 in qualified expenses

Hi, my name is Caitlin, Senior Manager, Technical Support at Customer.io , and I'm looking for an Email Deliverability Specialist to join our deliverability program within Technical Support. title: Deployed Architect, Professional Services (APAC)
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Deployed Architect to join our Professional Services team. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, deploy, and optimize production-grade AI infrastructure and agent systems. You'll be responsible for architecting scalable, secure infrastructure deployments and building reliable, well-evaluated agent applications that solve real business problems.

This role combines software development, infrastructure/platform engineering, and customer-facing skills. You'll work on everything from Kubernetes cluster design to multi-agent system architecture, requiring deep technical expertise across both infrastructure and agent engineering domains.

This role offers direct impact on customer success, the opportunity to shape best practices, and work with cutting-edge AI technology. You'll join a collaborative team environment with a strong engineering culture.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Infrastructure & Platform Engineering: Design scalable, highly-available infrastructure for AI platform deployments (compute, storage, networking, security), enterprise integration patterns, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm), multi-region HA/DR strategies, and CI/CD pipelines

- Agent Engineering & Development: Design multi-agent systems using different patterns, implement agent logic using modern frameworks (langchain/langgraph), design comprehensive evaluation frameworks, optimize prompts with A/B testing, and guide deployment/operations

- Customer Engagement & Assessment: Lead technical maturity assessments, work directly with enterprise customers to understand requirements and present recommendations, and partner with Engagement Managers and Product/Engineering teams

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

7+ years of experience in a technical, hands-on customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Deployed Architect or Forward Deployed Engineer. We also like former founders, so if you have an unusual background, but all the right skillsets, you are welcome to apply

Infrastructure & Platform:

- 3+ years of experience designing and deploying production infrastructure on cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure)

- Strong Kubernetes experience (GKE, EKS, or AKS) including cluster design, autoscaling, and multi-zone deployments

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm) and GitOps practices

- Knowledge of database systems (relational databases, in-memory data stores) including HA, replication, backup strategies, and sizing

- Experience designing high-availability and disaster recovery solutions

- Strong understanding of networking, security (SSO/RBAC, TLS, secrets management)
